review_status: Engineering snapshot; final release is not established by this geometry analysis.
method: Native saved filled polygons plus effective pad/track copper, own drill interiors subtracted. No refilling or saving. Fixed 0.02 mm cross-sections.
limitations: Cross-sections are local samples, not global minimum cuts.
Native per-layer pad connection flags are local adjacency checks; they do not prove connection to the complete net. No external bars are added to the native copper model.
Per-field via resistance assumes that all counted barrels share current uniformly; a field total does not establish a local transfer rating.
No resistance, temperature, SOA or pressfit measurement was performed.

via_formula: R = rho(T) * L / (N * pi * d * t); d = 0.4 mm, t = 0.025 mm, L = 1.6 mm; rho20 = 1.724e-8 ohm m, alpha = 0.00393/K

chopper_drain_copper.limitation: Area includes same-net pad/track/zone copper connected to Q40 drain on F.Cu, with drill/clearance holes removed. This is not a thermal-resistance measurement.

local_chopper_transfer.assumptions: Same barrel formula as field table; all local barrels ideally share 9.3 A.

engineering_findings.finding: RSH2 force-pad island found in the first routed snapshot a5fda347cb9910f0fb1f6774115fe7ddc8b8b0febc5a2a40d5e64ee023662d6b; a broad locked force link and rerouting were requested.
engineering_findings.status: Geometric connection restored in this snapshot; repeat after any routing changes.

engineering_findings.finding: BATT_N F.Cu is interrupted by SYS feed at x = 110 mm; B.Cu has 24.98 mm in the limited sampling window. Rev A-P1 extends the lower return to y=137 mm. BB7 reinforcement remains required.
Large via-field totals do not establish local current sharing; shunt force pads and FET leads enter from F.Cu only.
LIFT_N inner pours were severed by signal routes in the first routed snapshot; protected centerline paths were requested.
engineering_findings.status: Both inner paths are geometrically restored in this snapshot; repeat after routing changes.
